traits.name: Death Throes
traits.text:
If a phlogiston bush is reduced to 0 or fewer hit points,
it explodes in a concussive blast of fire in a 10-foot radius. All creatures
within the area must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (5d6)
fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The phlogiston bush makes two attacks with its tendrils.

actions.name: Tendrils
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17
(4d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Bolt
actions.text:
Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 40 ft., one target.
Hit: 10 (3d6) fire damage.
